purpose: Freeze the E0 scientific state/storage admissibility rule using only the admitted complete PUB-P2E08 Reference self-disagreement dataset, before any new broad RossFast matrix discrepancies are generated or inspected.

calibration_domain.construction: one Reference solve over 0.0064 day versus two sequential Reference solves over 0.0032 + 0.0032 day

stratification_decision.reference_only_rationale: P2E08 self-disagreement changes by orders of magnitude across the predeclared normalized initial-state axis: maximum U_h_inf is approximately 0.00233, 0.02488 and 1.03049 cm at Se 0.65, 0.85 and 0.98 respectively. Forcing-level distributions are similar, while material-level differences partly encode the same state dependence with only nine cases per material. Se is already a predeclared physically normalized coordinate and therefore provides the least post-hoc, most interpretable bounded stratification.
stratification_decision.scope_limit: The three thresholds apply only to the exact discrete E0 Se levels. They are not an interpolated continuous function of Se and do not generalize beyond the calibrated E0 domain.

threshold_rule.reference_scale_statistic: empirical maximum over all 18 admitted P2E08 Reference cases in the Se stratum
threshold_rule.why_maximum: The future broad E0 matrix uses the same bounded physical strata, so P2E09 freezes a nonparametric containment envelope rather than inferring a population quantile. A p95 rule would place at least one admitted Reference self-disagreement outside its own calibration envelope.
threshold_rule.why_factor_one: No independent evidence justifies inflating or shrinking the complete-domain Reference envelope. A factor above one would be an arbitrary safety margin and a factor below one would cease to contain the admitted Reference calibration data.
threshold_rule.why_zero_application_floor: No independent application-resolution authority with the same physical interpretation has been admitted. P2E09 therefore does not invent one.
threshold_rule.claim_ceiling: These thresholds are empirical Reference-calibration envelopes for the exact E0 domain, not formal true-solution error bounds, not production solver tolerances and not universal SWAP accuracy requirements.

future_case_admissibility_rule.state_storage: A paired E0 case passes the scientific discrepancy criterion only if every one of D_h_inf, D_h_rms, D_theta_inf, D_theta_rms and D_storage_abs is <= the frozen threshold for that case's exact Se stratum.
future_case_admissibility_rule.mass: Mass remains a separate hard route-level validity gate using typed integrated residuals; state agreement cannot compensate for a mass/conservation failure.
future_case_admissibility_rule.route_validity: Both routes must execute the separately preregistered common paired protocol through their declared solver routes without fallback and remain finite and physically representable.
future_case_admissibility_rule.prescribed_fluxes: No predicted top- or bottom-flux discrepancy tolerance is defined for E0 because both boundaries are prescribed inputs in this experiment.

temporal_interpretation_boundary.statement: P2E08 supplies an empirical complete-domain Reference self-disagreement envelope at 0.0064 versus two 0.0032-day steps. P2E09 does not assume a formal temporal order or Richardson extrapolation because no such order is taken as an admitted authority here.
temporal_interpretation_boundary.future_evaluation_requirement: The broad RossFast paired temporal protocol must be separately preregistered and held identical between solvers. P2E09 thresholds may not be silently reinterpreted as schedule-independent mathematical error bounds.

required: replay the exact admitted P2E08 Reference-only extraction without compiling the RossFast numerical solver
recompute all five empirical maxima independently within each of the three Se strata
verify the recomputed values equal the frozen threshold values
verify 18 Reference cases contribute to each Se stratum and all 54 physical cases are retained
verify no src/** or reference/** mutation
verify no threshold file changes after broad RossFast evaluation begins
O0/O2 reproducibility inherited and rechecked through the exact P2E08 replay
full relevant canonical preservation gates on the resulting PR

next_permitted_action: Implement a publication-only validator that replays the admitted P2E08 Reference extraction and proves the frozen Se-stratified thresholds are exactly the empirical Reference maxima. Do not execute RossFast. After admission, preregister the broad E0 paired RossFast-versus-Reference matrix and its common temporal protocol before generating new RossFast discrepancies.
